notes: Camera starts OFF — the app never starts the camera or asks for permission until you tap Camera: on. The placeholder says Camera off — turn it on to start. Hand signs work on the hand alone: any extended finger counts, 1 finger starts, 2 fingers stop, same rule for both, no face needed. The body rig only draws when real torso anchors (a shoulder AND a hip) are seen, and it vanishes the moment the body leaves. The rig snaps to the latest landmarks every frame — no smoothing lag. A preview that stays black now says so instead of showing Watching over a black box.
